gloss: to turn pale; to go white

definitions.gloss: to turn pale; to go white; to blanch
definitions.explanation: To lose color in the face due to fear, shock, illness, or extreme emotion. The face takes on a pale, bloodless appearance. Almost always describes a visible physical reaction to something alarming.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{恐怖|きょうふ}で{青|あお}ざめた。
{事故|じこ}の{知|し}らせを{聞|き}いて、{彼女|かのじょ}の{顔|かお}が{青|あお}ざめた。
examples.english: Her face went pale when she heard the news of the accident.

examples.japanese: {青|あお}ざめた{顔|かお}で{病院|びょういん}から{出|で}てきた{彼|かれ}を{見|み}て、{何|なに}かあったのだと{悟|さと}った。
examples.english: Seeing him come out of the hospital with a pale face, I realized something had happened.

notes:
USAGE:
{青|あお}ざめる is most often used with {顔|かお} (face) as the subject, or with the person as the subject (implying their face). The past participle {青|あお}ざめた is frequently used as a modifier: {青|あお}ざめた{顔|かお} (a pale face).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顔|かお}が{青|あお}ざめる (one's face turns pale)
- {恐怖|きょうふ}で{青|あお}ざめる (to turn pale with fear)
- {青|あお}ざめた{顔|かお} (a pale/ashen face)
- {青|あお}ざめた{表情|ひょうじょう} (a pale expression)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {青|あお}ざめる: to turn pale (face loses color; fear/shock)
- {青白|あおじろ}い: pale, pallid (adjective describing complexion)
- {血|ち}の{気|け}が{引|ひ}く: the blood drains from one's face (stronger expression)
